text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board approval for a bargaining mandate to negotiate the collective agreement with IATSE B-173 (Front of House) at TO Live venues.

The TO Live - Human Resources and Stakeholder Relations Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approve the bargaining mandate to negotiate a new collective bargaining agreement with IATSE B-173 at TO Live venues, as detailed in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (August 12, 2024) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Direct that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (August 12, 2024) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in its entirety, as it is about labour relations or employee negotiations.
